    15→/**
    16→ * Darkens blue colors in a bitmap for better visibility on light map backgrounds.
    17→ *
    18→ * Applies a darkening filter to blue-ish pixels while preserving transparency.
    19→ * Makes light blues darker by reducing RGB values proportionally.
    20→ *
    21→ * @param bitmap Original bitmap to darken
    22→ * @return New bitmap with darkened blue colors
    23→ */
    24→private fun darkenBlueColors(bitmap: Bitmap): Bitmap {
    25→    val width = bitmap.width
    26→    val height = bitmap.height
    27→    val darkenedBitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
    28→
    29→    for (x in 0 until width) {
    30→        for (y in 0 until height) {
    31→            val pixel = bitmap.getPixel(x, y)
    32→            val alpha = android.graphics.Color.alpha(pixel)
    33→
    34→            if (alpha > 0) { // Only process non-transparent pixels
    35→                val red = android.graphics.Color.red(pixel)
    36→                val green = android.graphics.Color.green(pixel)
    37→                val blue = android.graphics.Color.blue(pixel)
    38→
    39→                // Check if pixel is blue-ish (blue channel is dominant)
    40→                if (blue > red && blue > green) {
    41→                    // Darken by reducing all RGB values by 30%
    42→                    val darkenedRed = (red * 0.7f).toInt()
    43→                    val darkenedGreen = (green * 0.7f).toInt()
    44→                    val darkenedBlue = (blue * 0.7f).toInt()
    45→
    46→                    darkenedBitmap.setPixel(x, y, android.graphics.Color.argb(
    47→                        alpha, darkenedRed, darkenedGreen, darkenedBlue
    48→                    ))
    49→                } else {
    50→                    // Keep non-blue pixels unchanged (white outline, etc.)
    51→                    darkenedBitmap.setPixel(x, y, pixel)
    52→                }
    53→            }
    54→        }
    55→    }
    56→
    57→    return darkenedBitmap
    58→}
    59→
    60→/**
    61→ * Helper function to create a navigation arrow bitmap from drawable resource.
    62→ *
    63→ * Loads the navigation arrow icon from drawable resources and converts it to a BitmapDescriptor.
    64→ * The arrow points upward (north) and will be rotated via the Marker's rotation parameter.
    65→ * Scales the icon to a reasonable size for map display and darkens blue colors for visibility.
    66→ *
    67→ * @param context Android context for accessing drawable resources
    68→ * @return BitmapDescriptor of the navigation arrow icon
    69→ */
    70→private fun createNavigationArrowIcon(context: android.content.Context): BitmapDescriptor {
    71→    // Load the navigation arrow drawable
    72→    val drawable = androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.getDrawable(
    73→        context,
    74→        com.example.bikeredlights.R.drawable.ic_navigation_arrow
    75→    )
    76→
    77→    if (drawable != null) {
    78→        // Target size in pixels (36dp * density for high-DPI screens)
    79→        val density = context.resources.displayMetrics.density
    80→        val targetSize = (36 * density).toInt() // 36dp in pixels
    81→
    82→        // Create bitmap at target size (scaled from original)
    83→        val originalBitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(
    84→            targetSize,
    85→            targetSize,
    86→            Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888
    87→        )
    88→        val canvas = Canvas(originalBitmap)
    89→        drawable.setBounds(0, 0, targetSize, targetSize)
    90→        drawable.draw(canvas)
    91→
    92→        // Darken the blue color for better visibility on light backgrounds
    93→        val darkenedBitmap = darkenBlueColors(originalBitmap)
    94→        return BitmapDescriptorFactory.fromBitmap(darkenedBitmap)
    95→    }
    96→
    97→    // Fallback to default blue marker if drawable not found
    98→    return MarkerType.CURRENT.toIcon()
    99→}

   101→/**
   102→ * Composable that renders a location marker on a Google Map with directional arrow support (Feature 007 - v0.6.1).
   103→ *
   104→ * This component displays a marker representing the user's current location:
   105→ * - **Always shows navigation arrow icon** (even when stationary)
   106→ * - **When moving (bearing available)**: Arrow rotates to show heading direction
   107→ * - **When stationary (bearing null)**: Arrow points north (0°)
   108→ *
   109→ * **Null Safety**:
   110→ * If location is null, nothing is rendered. This handles the case when GPS
   111→ * signal is not yet available or location permissions are denied.
   112→ *
   113→ * **Accessibility**:
   114→ * The marker has a content description for screen readers via the title parameter.
   115→ *
   116→ * @param location The GPS coordinates for the marker. Null if location unavailable.
   117→ * @param bearing GPS bearing in degrees (0-360) for directional arrow rotation. Null defaults to 0° (north).
   118→ * @param title Optional title text displayed when marker is tapped (default: "Current Location")
   119→ *
   120→ * Example usage:
   121→ * ```
   122→ * val currentBearing by viewModel.currentBearing.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
   123→ * BikeMap {
   124→ *     LocationMarker(
   125→ *         location = viewModel.currentLocation,
   126→ *         bearing = currentBearing
   127→ *     )
   128→ * }
   129→ * ```
   130→ */
   131→@Composable
   132→fun LocationMarker(
   133→    location: LatLng?,
   134→    bearing: Float? = null,
   135→    title: String = "Current Location"
   136→) {
   137→    // Don't render if no location available
   138→    if (location == null) return
   139→
   140→    val context = androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext.current
   141→
   142→    // Create navigation arrow icon (cached via remember)
   143→    val navigationArrow = remember { createNavigationArrowIcon(context) }
   144→
   145→    Marker(
   146→        state = remember(location) { MarkerState(position = location) },
   147→        title = if (bearing != null) {
   148→            "$title (heading ${bearing.toInt()}°)"
   149→        } else {
   150→            title
   151→        },
   152→        icon = navigationArrow, // Always use navigation arrow
   153→        rotation = bearing ?: 0f, // Rotate to bearing, or point north (0°) when stationary
   154→        flat = true // Makes marker stick to map plane (important for rotation visibility)
   155→    )
   156→}

    27→/**
    28→ * Reusable Material 3-styled Google Maps composable wrapper for BikeRedlights.
    29→ *
    30→ * This composable provides a consistent map experience across the app with:
    31→ * - Material 3 dark mode support (automatically switches based on system theme)
    32→ * - Optimized UI controls for cycling use case
    33→ * - Custom camera position management
    34→ * - Directional map orientation (rotates to follow rider's heading) (Feature 007 - v0.6.1)
    35→ * - Slot pattern for flexible content injection (markers, polylines, etc.)
    36→ *
    37→ * **Material 3 Integration**:
    38→ * - Dark mode: Uses Google Maps dark theme when system dark mode is enabled
    39→ * - Light mode: Uses standard Google Maps light theme
    40→ *
    41→ * **Accessibility**:
    42→ * - Map controls (zoom, compass, location) have 48dp minimum touch targets
    43→ * - All interactive elements have content descriptions (set by Google Maps SDK)
    44→ *
    45→ * @param modifier Modifier for the map container
    46→ * @param cameraPositionState State holder for camera position (use rememberCameraPositionState())
    47→ * @param currentBearing GPS bearing in degrees (0-360) or null for north-up (Feature 007 - v0.6.1)
    48→ * @param mapType Type of map tiles (NORMAL, SATELLITE, HYBRID, TERRAIN)
    49→ * @param showMyLocationButton Whether to show the "My Location" FAB (default true)
    50→ * @param showZoomControls Whether to show zoom +/- buttons (default true)
    51→ * @param navigationMode When true, positions rider in lower third of map for better forward visibility (default true)
    52→ * @param content Slot for map content (Markers, Polylines, etc.)
    53→ *
    54→ * Example usage:
    55→ * ```
    56→ * val cameraPosition = rememberCameraPositionState {
    57→ *     position = CameraPosition.fromLatLngZoom(LatLng(37.422, -122.084), 17f)
    58→ * }
    59→ * val currentBearing by viewModel.currentBearing.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    60→ * BikeMap(
    61→ *     cameraPositionState = cameraPosition,
    62→ *     currentBearing = currentBearing,
    63→ *     modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
    64→ * ) {
    65→ *     // Map content (markers, polylines)
    66→ *     Marker(position = LatLng(37.422, -122.084), title = "Current Location")
    67→ *     Polyline(points = routePoints, color = Color.Red)
    68→ * }
    69→ * ```
    70→ */
    71→@Composable
    72→fun BikeMap(
    73→    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    74→    cameraPositionState: CameraPositionState = rememberCameraPositionState {
    75→        position = CameraPosition.fromLatLngZoom(
    76→            LatLng(37.422, -122.084), // Default to Google campus
    77→            17f // City block level zoom (50-200m radius)
    78→        )
    79→    },
    80→    currentBearing: Float? = null,
    81→    mapType: MapType = MapType.NORMAL,
    82→    showMyLocationButton: Boolean = true,
    83→    showZoomControls: Boolean = true,
    84→    navigationMode: Boolean = true,
    85→    content: @Composable () -> Unit = {}
    86→) {
    87→    val isDarkMode = isSystemInDarkTheme()
    88→    val context = LocalContext.current
    89→
    90→    // Track last animated bearing for debouncing (Feature 007 - v0.6.1)
    91→    var lastAnimatedBearing by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(0f) }
    92→
    93→    // Animate camera bearing changes with debouncing (Feature 007 - v0.6.1)
    94→    // Only animate if bearing changes by more than 5 degrees to prevent jitter
    95→    // Uses 300ms smooth animation for natural map rotation
    96→    LaunchedEffect(currentBearing) {
    97→        if (currentBearing != null) {
    98→            val bearingDelta = abs(currentBearing - lastAnimatedBearing)
    99→
   100→            // Debouncing: Only animate if change > 5 degrees
   101→            // This prevents jittery map rotation from minor GPS fluctuations
   102→            if (bearingDelta > 5f) {
   103→                launch {
   104→                    cameraPositionState.animate(
   105→                        update = com.google.android.gms.maps.CameraUpdateFactory.newCameraPosition(
   106→                            CameraPosition.Builder(cameraPositionState.position)
   107→                                .bearing(currentBearing)
   108→                                .build()
   109→                        ),
   110→                        durationMs = 300 // Smooth 300ms animation
   111→                    )
   112→                    lastAnimatedBearing = currentBearing
   113→                }
   114→            }
   115→        } else {
   116→            // No bearing available: reset to north-up (bearing = 0)
   117→            if (lastAnimatedBearing != 0f) {
   118→                launch {
   119→                    cameraPositionState.animate(
   120→                        update = com.google.android.gms.maps.CameraUpdateFactory.newCameraPosition(
   121→                            CameraPosition.Builder(cameraPositionState.position)
   122→                                .bearing(0f)
   123→                                .build()
   124→                        ),
   125→                        durationMs = 300
   126→                    )
   127→                    lastAnimatedBearing = 0f
   128→                }
   129→            }
   130→        }
   131→    }
   132→
   133→    // Map properties for Material 3 theming with dark mode support
   134→    // Using Google's predefined dark mode style JSON
   135→    val mapProperties = remember(isDarkMode, mapType) {
   136→        MapProperties(
   137→            mapType = mapType,
   138→            isMyLocationEnabled = false, // We'll handle location markers manually for better control
   139→            mapStyleOptions = if (isDarkMode) {
   140→                // Simple dark mode JSON style
   141→                MapStyleOptions("""
   142→                    [
   143→                      {"elementType": "geometry", "stylers": [{"color": "#242f3e"}]},
   144→                      {"elementType": "labels.text.fill", "stylers": [{"color": "#746855"}]},
   145→                      {"elementType": "labels.text.stroke", "stylers": [{"color": "#242f3e"}]},
   146→                      {"featureType": "road", "elementType": "geometry", "stylers": [{"color": "#38414e"}]},
   147→                      {"featureType": "road", "elementType": "geometry.stroke", "stylers": [{"color": "#212a37"}]},
   148→                      {"featureType": "road", "elementType": "labels.text.fill", "stylers": [{"color": "#9ca5b3"}]},
   149→                      {"featureType": "water", "elementType": "geometry", "stylers": [{"color": "#17263c"}]}
   150→                    ]
   151→                """.trimIndent())
   152→            } else {
   153→                null // Use default light style
   154→            }
   155→        )
   156→    }
   157→
   158→    // Map UI settings optimized for cycling use case
   159→    val mapUiSettings = remember(showMyLocationButton, showZoomControls) {
   160→        MapUiSettings(
   161→            zoomControlsEnabled = showZoomControls,
   162→            myLocationButtonEnabled = showMyLocationButton,
   163→            compassEnabled = true, // Helpful for navigation
   164→            rotationGesturesEnabled = true, // Allow map rotation
   165→            tiltGesturesEnabled = false, // Disable 3D tilt (not useful for cycling)
   166→            scrollGesturesEnabled = true,
   167→            zoomGesturesEnabled = true
   168→        )
   169→    }
   170→
   171→    GoogleMap(
   172→        modifier = modifier.fillMaxSize(),
   173→        cameraPositionState = cameraPositionState,
   174→        properties = mapProperties,
   175→        uiSettings = mapUiSettings,
   176→        contentPadding = if (navigationMode) PaddingValues(bottom = 200.dp) else PaddingValues(),
   177→        content = content
   178→    )
   179→}
